```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
```

# Import plate_assignments

```{r}
data <- read_rds(here::here("data","derived","run_001_plate_assignments.rds"))
```

# Make extraction book

This will be an excel file with instructions on which samples to extract into which plates

```{r}
# ---- Make the 8x12 layout tibble (NO metadata rows) ----
make_plate_layout <- function(ids_94) {
  ids_94 <- ids_94 %>%
    head(94) %>%
    { c(., rep("", 94 - length(.))) }

  ids_96 <- c(ids_94, "", "")

  mat <- matrix(ids_96, nrow = 8, ncol = 12, byrow = TRUE)

  tibble(Row = LETTERS[1:8]) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(mat) %>% set_names(as.character(1:12)))
}
```

```{r}
make_all_plate_layouts <- function(data) {
  stopifnot(all(c("tube_id", "plate_num", "project_id") %in% names(data)))

  data %>%
    arrange(plate_num) %>%
    group_by(plate_num) %>%
    summarise(
      project_id = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(project_id))), collapse = ", "),
      ids = list(tube_id),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      plate_tbl = pmap(
        list(ids, plate_num, project_id),
        function(ids_94, plate_num, project_id) {

          plate_id <- paste0("plate_", plate_num)

          # two metadata rows (plate + project) in the "Row" column
          header_rows <- tibble(Row = c(plate_id, project_id)) %>%
            bind_cols(
              as_tibble(matrix("", nrow = 2, ncol = 12)) %>%
                set_names(as.character(1:12))
            )

          # NEW: a row that contains the 1..12 labels as cell values
          col_label_row <- tibble(Row = "") %>%
            bind_cols(
              as_tibble(matrix(as.character(1:12), nrow = 1)) %>%
                set_names(as.character(1:12))
            )

          bind_rows(
            header_rows,
            col_label_row,              # <-- labels now sit right above A row
            make_plate_layout(ids_94),  # A-H rows with IDs
            tibble(Row = "", !!!set_names(rep(list(""), 12), as.character(1:12)))
          )
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    select(plate_tbl) %>%
    unnest(plate_tbl)
}
```

```{r}
layout <- make_all_plate_layouts(data)
```

# Name of file to produce

```{r}
file_name <- "run_001_extraction_sheet.xlsx"
```

```{r}
# Helper: Excel sheet name helper (max 31 chars, no []:*?/\, unique)
sanitize_sheet_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[\\[\\]\\:\\*\\?\\/\\\\]", "_", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  ifelse(nchar(x) > 31, substr(x, 1, 31), x)
}

stopifnot("project_id" %in% names(data))

# -------------------------
# Build workbook fresh each run
# -------------------------
wb <- createWorkbook()

# -------------------------
# Sheet 1: Plates (layout + formatting)
# -------------------------
addWorksheet(wb, "Plates")

# Write stacked layout
writeData(wb, "Plates", layout, startRow = 1, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)

# Column widths (nice for plate viewing)
setColWidths(wb, "Plates", cols = 1, widths = 10)     # Row / metadata col
setColWidths(wb, "Plates", cols = 2:13, widths = 18)  # wells

# Styles
grid_style <- createStyle(
  border = "TopBottomLeftRight",
  borderStyle = "thin",
  halign = "center",
  valign = "center"
)

label_style <- createStyle(
  fgFill = "#D9D9D9",
  border = "TopBottomLeftRight",
  borderStyle = "thin",
  halign = "center",
  valign = "center",
  textDecoration = "bold"
)

meta_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold")

# Find each plate’s label row (the row with "1" in column "1")
# This assumes you built layout with an explicit 1..12 label row per plate:
# Row == "" and column `1` == "1"
label_rows <- which(layout$Row == "" & layout$`1` == "1")
if (length(label_rows) == 0) {
  stop("Couldn't find any plate label rows. Expected rows where Row=='' and column '1' == '1'.")
}

# Apply styles for each plate block
for (label_top in label_rows) {

  # label row + A..H = 9 rows; columns Row + 12 wells = 13 cols
  grid_rows <- label_top:(label_top + 8)
  grid_cols <- 1:13

  # Borders around every cell in the plate grid
  addStyle(wb, "Plates", grid_style,
           rows = grid_rows, cols = grid_cols,
           gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  # Gray fill on the label row ("" + 1..12)
  addStyle(wb, "Plates", label_style,
           rows = label_top, cols = grid_cols,
           gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  # Gray fill on the first column (Row labels A..H + top-left)
  addStyle(wb, "Plates", label_style,
           rows = grid_rows, cols = 1,
           gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  # Bold the two metadata lines above the label row (plate_id, project_id)
  addStyle(wb, "Plates", meta_style,
           rows = (label_top - 2):(label_top - 1), cols = 1,
           gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
}

# Optional: freeze the first column so row letters/metadata stay visible while scrolling
freezePane(wb, "Plates", firstCol = TRUE)

# -------------------------
# Additional sheets: one per project_id (raw rows)
# -------------------------
project_vals <- data %>%
  distinct(project_id) %>%
  pull(project_id)

sheet_names <- project_vals %>%
  sanitize_sheet_name() %>%
  make.unique(sep = "_")

for (i in seq_along(project_vals)) {
  pid <- project_vals[i]
  sh  <- sheet_names[i]

  df_proj <- data %>% filter(project_id == pid)

  addWorksheet(wb, sh)
  writeData(wb, sh, df_proj, startRow = 1, startCol = 1, colNames = TRUE)

  freezePane(wb, sh, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sh, cols = 1:ncol(df_proj), widths = "auto")
}

# -------------------------
# Save workbook
# -------------------------
saveWorkbook(wb, here::here("data","derived",file_name), overwrite = TRUE)
```
